verdict.rationale: Kit documents audience tagging and segmentation as a product feature, and segments are first-class objects: broadcasts can target segment or tag ids, and the Kit MCP exposes segments. Custom fields exist as subscriber attributes, but nothing shows segments being built from them or from behavioral events, or recalculating live as data changes. missing for 10: documented segment-builder criteria (custom fields, tags, behavioral events), evidence that segments update dynamically as data changes, independent or hands-on corroboration
